stage1.impression: A canal quay at blue hour with a glowing six-ring globe on a black plinth, gabled terrace across the water. The globe's coloured rims read at a glance and the idea is striking. But the place reads as a game level: the house fronts are flat brown boxes with flat colour-block windows, the people are mannequin pegs, the paving is a uniform orange tile, and a theatrical white spot pool sits on the ground. A jury would see a specific, striking work, but in a generic render rather than a real Amsterdam night. (Brief mismatch: the rubric describes a listening bar interior; this frame is an exterior light-festival proposal and was judged as a night photograph of that.)

blocking_9: The house fronts across the canal need real brick, stone sills, cornices and varied window interiors (curtains, lamps, ceilings), not flat brown planes with flat colour-block panes (wall patch [995,100,1040,200] lum_range 11.8)
The figures must read as people (clothed, varied poses, a bicycle being walked), or be removed; the peg figures at [80,385,130,560] and [940,395,965,460] say game
The quay needs believable night paving: wet or damp setts with gloss that picks up the rims' colours and the lamps, instead of uniform matte orange tiles
The globe's 25 mm acrylic discs must read as thick clear acrylic: faint face reflections and glowing edge bloom in the haze, not thin neon hoops on dark tinted faces
The coloured shadow on the paving has to be the vivid, readable second image the card promises; now it is a desaturated pink and violet smear inside a neutral white ring
The frame needs one coherent light: the 4500 K white spot pool against a 2200 K orange street, plus a purple haze bloom at the lamp, reads as two renders combined
The barrier ring and its posts must stop cutting through the globe and plinth in the foreground
Amsterdam has to be specific: real narrow gabled canal houses (step, neck or bell gables, hoist beams), canal trees or a bridge, houseboats

defects.what: Facades are flat untextured brown planes; windows are flat colour blocks with no depth, interior or reflection; repeated identical grid
Houses read as a modern block with chimneys, not Amsterdam canal gables; identical window modules repeated
Near figure is a peg mannequin (cylinder body, ball head)
Far figure is a peg mannequin
Spot pool: hard neutral-white ring around a weak, desaturated coloured shadow; reads as a stage spot on a set
Paving is uniform matte orange tiles, no wear, no damp, no gloss; strongly saturated (r 78, g 41, b 23)
Lamp halo is a large purple-pink bloom in the sky; sky region median 86 is the brightest large area, flat CG gradient
Disc faces read dark tinted and empty; rims read as neon tubes with no glow in the haze and no edge bloom
Barrier ring and black posts cross the globe and plinth; post at x 255 cuts the plinth face
Canal water is dark and smooth; reflections are vertical smears with no ripple break-up and no colour from the globe
Fine render grain in sky and facades at 1:1

changes.problem: The houses across the canal read as flat CG boxes, which is the strongest render tell in the frame.

evidence.measured: wall patch lum_range 11.8, lum_median 19.9: no brick, mortar or weathering; windows are flat colour blocks

change.setting: houses: materials' finish (brick) and window interiors
change.from: flat brown wall, flat emissive panes, 0.32 lit at glow 0.1
change.to: dark red-brown brick with mortar, bump and soot streaks, white-painted stone sills and frames; panes as glass with a room behind (curtain, ceiling lamp, back wall) at varied 2400-3000 K; keep 0.32 lit but vary glow 0.05-0.2 per window

changes.expected: Facades carry visible brick texture and depth; windows read as rooms at night.

changes.problem: The five figures are peg mannequins that read as a game.

evidence.measured: seen: cylinder body, sphere head, no clothing

change.to: 2-3 scanned clothed people (a couple looking up at the globe on this quay, one walking a bicycle across the water), soft in focus; or none

changes.expected: Sign of life that reads as visitors on the canal route.

changes.problem: The paving is uniform matte orange tile, so the quay neither reads as real nor carries the globe's colour.

evidence.measured: lum_range 44.7, r 78 g 41 b 23, no specular

change.setting: the paving and stone kerb finish
change.to: grey brick or granite setts, damp after rain: roughness 0.25-0.45 varied by a puddle mask, darker joints, kerb in worn bluestone

changes.expected: Coloured streaks of the rims and lamp glints in the foreground paving; ground no longer a flat orange field.

changes.problem: The coloured shadow, the work's second image, is weak and sits inside a neutral white ring that reads as a stage spot.

evidence.measured: lum_median 67.8; profile across x 500-1000 peaks 91.6 in the white ring, shadow colours desaturated pink and violet

change.from: 650 W, cone 16 deg, 4500 K, aimed at [0.3,-2.0,0]
change.to: 900 W, cone 11 deg with a soft 2 deg blend, 3200 K, aimed at [0.6,-1.6,0] so the pool is mostly filled by the globe's shadow

changes.expected: A vivid six-colour shadow pattern with little bare white ring; spot warm enough to sit with the street.

changes.problem: The whole frame is pushed orange-brown, so the neutral surfaces compete with the globe as colour and the white spot looks foreign.

evidence.measured: houses r 47 g 25 b 16; paving r 78 g 41 b 23

changes.expected: Surfaces warm but closer to neutral; the globe is the only saturated colour on the quay.

changes.problem: The rims read as thin neon hoops and the faces as dark tinted sheets, not thick rim-lit acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 32.9, p95 188.7, clip 1.16 % on the rims, no halo in the haze

change.to: emission 0.24, haze 0.010 /m, with a faint face reflection (disc roughness 0.02, clear IOR 1.49)

changes.expected: Rims with soft bloom in the air, faces showing the lamps' and windows' reflections, so the discs read as thick clear acrylic.

changes.problem: The sky and the lamp halo are the brightest large area and read as a purple CG gradient.
changes.expected: A deep blue-hour sky behind the gables; the lamp keeps a small halo, not a purple wash.

changes.problem: The barrier ring and its posts cross the globe and plinth and clutter the foreground.

evidence.measured: seen: post at x 255 cuts the plinth face, rope crosses the lower rims

change.to: remove it, or r 2.6 m with rope at 0.45 m so it passes below the plinth top

changes.expected: The plinth and globe silhouette are uncut.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the terrace with true Amsterdam canal houses (narrow, step, neck and bell gables, hoist beams), and add canal elms, a bridge or a houseboat
out_of_scope.why: The card lets me change house materials and small props but not the house geometry or the site layout; this is the biggest step toward a specific, real Amsterdam and needs the owner's approval as an asset change

out_of_scope.request: Move the camera lower and more along the quay, about 1.2 m high, so the canal behind takes the globe's reflection
out_of_scope.why: The camera may change, but this re-frames the site and the jury's first view; propose it as a variant rather than a fix
